blocks.text: Birovning gapini boshqaga yetkazishning ikki usuli bor. **Ko'chirma gap** — so'zma-so'z, qo'shtirnoq ichida: Aziz said, "I'm tired." **O'zlashtirma gap** (reported speech) — o'z so'zlarimiz bilan: Aziz said (that) he **was** tired. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Aziz: „Charchadim“, — dedi» va «Aziz **charchaganini** aytdi». Farqi shundaki, o'zbekchada fe'l `-gan`, `-ish` + `-ini` shakliga o'tadi, zamon esa deyarli o'zgarmaydi. Ingliz tilida esa o'zlashtirma gapda **zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi**: am → was, will → would, can → could.

rows: He said he **was going to** buy it.
She said she **had lost** her key.

items.text: Madina said she **was** very happy in London.
Tom said he **would** be home at eight.
Aziz told me he **couldn't** find a job.

blocks.text: Zamon bilan birga olmoshlar ham gapiruvchiga qarab o'zgaradi (o'zbekchada ham): "**I** like **my** job." → She said **she** liked **her** job. Vaziyat o'zgargan bo'lsa, joy va vaqt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi: here → **there**, today → **that day**, tomorrow → **the next day**, yesterday → **the day before**.

**said** — o'tgan zamon. Biz gap aytilgan paytga «qaytib», o'sha paytdagi holatni tasvirlaymiz: Aziz said he **was** tired — u o'shanda charchagan edi, hozir esa balki dam olgandir. Agar aytilgan narsa hozir ham to'g'ri bo'lsa (umumiy fakt yoki hali ham o'zgarmagan holat), hozirgi zamonni saqlash ham mumkin: Tom said he **is** from London. The teacher said the earth **goes** round the sun. Lekin orqaga surish hech qachon xato bo'lmaydi — ikkilansangiz, orqaga suring.

items.text: Aziz said he **was** tired, but now he feels fine.
items.translation: Aziz **charchaganini** aytgan edi, hozir esa o'zini yaxshi his qilyapti.

items.text: Tom said he **is** from London — he still lives there.
items.translation: Tom Londondan **ekanini** aytdi — u hali ham o'sha yerda yashaydi.

items.text: "I'll meet you here tomorrow." — Emma said she would meet us **there the next day**.
items.translation: «Ertaga shu yerda uchrashamiz.» — Emma ertasi kuni **o'sha yerda** uchrashishimizni aytdi.

blocks.text: Asosiy fe'l hozirgi zamonda bo'lsa (**says**, **tells**), zamon o'zgarmaydi: Madina **says** she **is** tired. Dilnoza **tells** me she **will** come. — Gap hozir aytilyapti, holat ham hozirgi.

O'zbekchada bitta «aytmoq» (yoki «demoq») bor, inglizchada esa ikki fe'l — ularning farqi **odam**da. **say** + (that) + gap — kimga aytilgani ko'rsatilmaydi: She **said** (that) she was ill. **tell** + **odam** + (that) + gap — kimga aytilgani albatta bo'ladi: She **told me** (that) she was ill. say bilan odamni qo'shmoqchi bo'lsangiz, **to** kerak: She said **to me** ... (kamroq ishlatiladi). Ikkala holatda ham **that** ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin.

rows: **tell** a story, **tell** a lie, **tell** the time

items.text: Sarah **told us** the film was boring.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He said me that ...» → **He told me that ...** yoki **He said that ...**; «She told that she was ill.» → **She told me that ...** / **She said that ...**; «Aziz said he is tired yesterday.» → **Aziz said he was tired.** (said dan keyin zamon orqaga); «He said he will come.» → **He said he would come.**; «She told to me ...» → **She told me ...**

Savol va iltimoslarni ham yetkazish mumkin. Savol — **asked** + bilvosita savol tartibi (→ 49-dars): "Where do you live?" → She **asked** me where I **lived**. Buyruq va iltimos — **told / asked** + odam + **to** + fe'l (→ 53-dars): "Wait here." → He **told me to wait** there.

Eslab qolish: **said / told** — «o'tmishga eshik». Undan keyingi fe'lni bir qadam orqaga suring: **is → was**, **do → did**, **will → would**, **can → could**, **has done → had done**. **tell** — doim kimgadir: tell **me**, tell **her**, tell **Tom**.

items: said / told dan keyin zamon bir pog'ona orqaga: am / is → **was**, are → **were**, like → **liked**, will → **would**, can → **could**, have done → **had done**.
Hali ham to'g'ri bo'lgan fakt — hozirgi zamon qolishi mumkin; says / tells dan keyin zamon o'zgarmaydi.
Olmoshlar va joy / vaqt so'zlari ham o'zgaradi: I → he / she, here → there, tomorrow → the next day.
**say** — odamsiz, **tell** — odam bilan: He said ... / He told me ...

examples.title: **said (that)** ... **was / were**
examples.description: Ko'chirma gapdagi am / is → o'zlashtirma gapda **was**, are → **were**, isn't → **wasn't**. **that** ni tushirib qoldirish mumkin.

sentences.text: Aziz said he **was** tired after the trip.
Madina told me her parents **were** in Samarkand.
The waiter said that the kitchen **was** closed.
Tom said the tickets **were** very expensive.
When I phoned, Sarah said she **wasn't** at home.
My doctor said I **was** perfectly healthy.
The children said they **were** hungry, so I made some sandwiches.
sentences.translation: Bolalar qorinlari **ochligini** aytishdi, shuning uchun buterbrod tayyorladim.

sentences.text: Bekzod told us that his new flat **was** near the river.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bizga yangi kvartirasi daryo **yaqinida ekanini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Everyone said the concert **was** fantastic.
Emma said she **was** sorry and that it **wasn't** her fault.
sentences.translation: Emma **afsusda ekanini** va bunda **aybi yo'qligini** aytdi.

examples.title: **live** → **lived**, **don't** → **didn't**
examples.description: Present Simple o'zlashtirma gapda Past Simple ga o'tadi: "I live in a village" → He said he **lived** in a village. Inkor: don't / doesn't → **didn't**. Umumiy fakt o'zgarmasligi mumkin (the earth **goes** ...).

sentences.text: James said he **lived** in a small village near Oxford.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Oksford yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda **yashashini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza told me she **didn't like** horror films.
My grandfather said he **got up** at five every morning.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kuni ertalab soat beshda **turishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: The shop assistant said the jacket **cost** two hundred pounds.
sentences.translation: Sotuvchi kurtka ikki yuz funt **turishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Aziz said he **knew** a good restaurant in the old city.
sentences.translation: Aziz eski shahardagi yaxshi bir restoranni **bilishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Sarah told us that her husband **worked** for a bank.
When I asked about the bus, the driver said it **didn't stop** here.
sentences.translation: Avtobus haqida so'raganimda, haydovchi u bu yerda **to'xtamasligini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod said he **wanted** to study medicine.
Our teacher said that the earth **goes** round the sun.
Madina said she **didn't have** time to meet us this week.
sentences.translation: Madina bu hafta biz bilan uchrashishga **vaqti yo'qligini** aytdi.

examples.title: **will** → **would**, **can** → **could**
examples.description: Modal fe'llar ham orqaga suriladi: will → **would**, won't → **wouldn't**, can → **could**, can't → **couldn't**. promise, the forecast said kabi gaplarda ham shunday.

sentences.text: Tom said he **would** call me after the meeting.
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishdan keyin menga **qo'ng'iroq qilishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Madina said she **couldn't** come to the party.
The forecast said it **would** be sunny all weekend.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotida dam olish kunlari quyoshli **bo'lishi** aytildi.

sentences.text: Aziz told me he **could** speak four languages.
sentences.translation: Aziz menga to'rt tilda **gapira olishini** aytdi.

sentences.text: You promised you **would** help me with the cooking!
sentences.translation: Ovqat pishirishga **yordam berishga** va'da bergan edingiz-ku!

sentences.text: The mechanic said he **couldn't** repair the car until Monday.
Emma said she **wouldn't** be late again.
My little brother told everyone he **could** swim, but it wasn't true.
sentences.translation: Ukam hammaga **suza olishini** aytdi, lekin bu rost emasdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod said the exam **would** be on Friday.
The receptionist said we **could** leave our bags at the hotel.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi sumkalarimizni mehmonxonada **qoldirishimiz mumkinligini** aytdi.

examples.title: **is doing** → **was doing**, **going to** → **was going to**
examples.description: Present Continuous → **Past Continuous** (was / were + -ing); am / is / are going to → **was / were going to**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza said she **was cooking** dinner, so she couldn't talk.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kechki ovqat **pishirayotganini**, shuning uchun gaplasha olmasligini aytdi.

sentences.text: Tom told me he **was going to** sell his car.
When I called, Aziz said he **was waiting** for a bus.
Sarah said they **were planning** a trip to Uzbekistan.
The children said they **weren't doing** anything wrong.
sentences.translation: Bolalar hech qanday yomon ish **qilmayotganlarini** aytishdi.

sentences.text: Madina told us she **was going to** have a baby.
My neighbour said he **was having** problems with his boiler.
Bekzod said it **was raining** heavily in Tashkent.
James told his boss he **wasn't feeling** well.
We said we **were going to** take a taxi, but in the end we walked.
sentences.translation: Taksiga **o'tirmoqchi ekanimizni** aytdik, lekin oxiri piyoda bordik.

examples.title: **have done** → **had done**
examples.description: Present Perfect o'zlashtirma gapda **had + V3** ga o'tadi: "I've lost my keys" → He said he **had lost** his keys. Past Simple ko'pincha o'zgarmaydi (she **met**) yoki **had + V3** bo'ladi (she **had worked**).

sentences.text: Aziz said he **had lost** his keys again.
Madina told me she **had never been** to London.
sentences.translation: Madina menga hech qachon Londonda **bo'lmaganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: The waiter said they **had run out** of soup, so we ordered salad.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant sho'rva **tugab qolganini** aytdi, shuning uchun salat buyurtma qildik.

sentences.text: Tom said he **hadn't seen** the film yet.
Sarah told us she **had already booked** the hotel.
sentences.translation: Sara bizga mehmonxonani allaqachon **bron qilganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod said he **enjoyed** his trip to Bukhara very much.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Buxoroga sayohati unga juda **yoqqanini** aytdi.

sentences.text: The police said someone **had broken** into the shop during the night.
sentences.translation: Politsiya kechasi kimdir do'konga **o'g'rilikka tushganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Emma said she **had worked** in a hospital before she became a teacher.
sentences.translation: Emma o'qituvchi bo'lishdan oldin shifoxonada **ishlaganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza told her mother that she **had passed** all her exams.
My friend said she **met** her husband at university.

examples.title: **say** or **tell**?
examples.description: **say** dan keyin odam kelmaydi: He **said** (that) ... **tell** dan keyin odam shart: He **told me** (that) ... Turg'un iboralar: **say** goodbye, **tell** a story, **tell** the truth.

sentences.text: Aziz **said** he was busy.
Aziz **told me** he was busy.
What did the dentist **say**? — She **said** my teeth were fine.
sentences.translation: Tish shifokori nima **dedi**? — Tishlarim sog'lom ekanini **aytdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **told** her parents the good news.
Please **tell** me the truth. What happened?
Tom **said** goodbye and left without a word.
Who **told** you that Bekzod was getting married?
Grandma **told** us a funny story about her childhood.
sentences.translation: Buvim bizga bolaligi haqida kulgili hikoya **aytib berdi**.

sentences.text: I **said to** Sarah that I would call her later.
Don't **tell** anyone, but I'm going to change my job.
sentences.translation: Hech kimga **aytmang**, lekin men ishimni almashtirmoqchiman.

examples.title: Direct → reported: **"I'm hungry"** → **he was hungry**
examples.description: Ko'chirma gap va uning o'zlashtirma varianti yonma-yon: zamon orqaga suriladi, olmoshlar (I → he, my → her) va joy so'zlari (here → there) o'zgaradi.

sentences.text: "I'm hungry." — Aziz said he **was** hungry.
"Coffee? No thanks, I don't like it." — Emma said she **didn't like** coffee.
sentences.translation: «Qahvami? Yo'q, rahmat, yoqtirmayman.» — Emma qahvani **yoqtirmasligini** aytdi.

sentences.text: "We'll be late." — They told us they **would** be late.
"I can't find my phone." — Madina said she **couldn't** find her phone.
"My brother is a pilot." — Bekzod told me his brother **was** a pilot.
sentences.translation: «Akam uchuvchi.» — Bekzod menga akasi **uchuvchi ekanini** aytdi.

sentences.text: "We're going to Bukhara." — My parents said they **were going** to Bukhara.
"Mum, I've finished my homework." — Tom told his mum he **had finished** his homework.
sentences.translation: «Oyi, uy vazifamni tugatdim.» — Tom oyisiga uy vazifasini **tugatganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: "It's very cold outside." — Dilnoza said it **was** very cold outside.
sentences.translation: «Tashqarida juda sovuq.» — Dilnoza tashqarida juda **sovuqligini** aytdi.

sentences.text: "The train doesn't stop here." — The guard told us the train **didn't stop** there.
sentences.translation: «Poyezd bu yerda to'xtamaydi.» — Konduktor bizga poyezd u yerda **to'xtamasligini** aytdi.

sentences.text: "I'll send you the photos tomorrow." — Sarah said she **would send** me the photos the next day.
sentences.translation: «Ertaga suratlarni yuboraman.» — Sara suratlarni ertasi kuni **yuborishini** aytdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: passing on a message
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: telefondagi xabarni yetkazish — **said / told me**, zamonning orqaga surilishi (was, would, had changed) va **say / tell** farqi.

sentences.text: — Aziz, your sister phoned while you were out. She **said** she **was** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: — Aziz, siz yo'qligingizda singlingiz qo'ng'iroq qildi. Toshkentda **ekanini aytdi**.

sentences.text: — In Tashkent? She **told me** she **was going** to Samarkand!
sentences.translation: — Toshkentdami? U menga Samarqandga **ketayotganini aytgan edi**-ku!

sentences.text: — Well, she **said** her plans **had changed**.
— Did she **say** why?
— Yes. She **said** the trains **were** full.
— Typical! Did she **say** when she **would** come back?
— She **told me** she **would** call you tonight.
— OK. What else did she **tell** you?
— Only that she **missed** you and **couldn't wait** to see you.
sentences.translation: — Faqat sizni **sog'inganini** va ko'rishishni **intiqlik bilan kutayotganini** aytdi.

sentences.text: — That's nice. Next time, please **tell** her to call my mobile.
sentences.translation: — Yoqimli. Keyingi safar unga mobil telefonimga qo'ng'iroq qilishini **ayting**.
